description: This file defines the LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport class, which implements an API report endpoint for generating leave entitlement and usage data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for defining report headers, filters, processing filter parameters, validation, and access control.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport
classes.description: Implements a report endpoint for leave entitlement and usage data, providing definitions for report header and filters, input validation, data retrieval, and access control within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines and returns the report's header columns, including employee name, leave entitlement, pending approval days, scheduled days, taken days, and balance days.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new, empty filter object for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the report data based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Processes request parameters to construct and return a FilterParams object, including date ranges and filtering options, respecting user permissions.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Provides validation rules for request parameters, ensuring proper entity IDs and date formats.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the report; throws ForbiddenException if not authorized.
